rules.title: How the advisor decides
rules.scope: In scope: every required training that is expired or never completed (non-compliant now), or that lapses within {months} months. People on parental leave are left out.
rules.remedied: A named booking on an upcoming session of the course is a planned remediation. If the session ends after the training lapses, the days in between are a gap.
rules.overbooking: Overbooked sessions come first: their unnamed seats move to other sessions of the same course that have room, and those seats are not offered again.
rules.order: Everything else needs action, served in this order: expired (longest expired first), never completed, then by the day it lapses; ties go by name.
rules.choice: Each takes a session with a free seat that does not clash with the person's other bookings: the earliest one if the training has lapsed; otherwise the last one that ends before it lapses, or the earliest one if none does.
rules.unplaced: When no session can take it, the reason is shown: nothing scheduled, every session full, or a clash.

planner.rule: Trainings no session can take are grouped by course and due date (lapsed ones within two weeks, the rest the day before they lapse) and split by the course's group size, or by the largest room that suits it. Each session gets the first working day from tomorrow (weekends and public holidays are not) with a valid room free at the course's usual time: online if the course allows it, otherwise a room with everything the course needs and enough seats, rooms used before first.
